'''Stephen 'Nigel' Kennedy''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[April 2000 Monrovia tournament]] on 29 April 2000 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit (EPP Han captive)]], according to Joe Fox's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d619">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-29-monrovia-in-my-house-4-29-00d619/ monrovia-in-my-house-4-29-00], DeckTech (Joe "JoeCool144" Fox, 29 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-29-monrovia-in-my-house-4-29-00d619/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
